summary.text: Tracy DiFlorio is the Republican candidate for the New York State Assembly, District 138, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which she faces incumbent Harry Bronson (Working Families Party and Democratic).
She was also the Republican and Conservative Party candidate for the seat in 2022 and 2024.

paragraphs.text: Tracy DiFlorio ran for the same Assembly seat in 2022 as the Republican and Conservative Party candidate and lost to incumbent Harry Bronson, receiving 40.5 percent of the vote to his 59.5 percent.
She ran against Bronson again in 2024 and received 38.7 percent of the vote to his 61.3 percent.
She advanced from the canceled Republican primary for the 2026 race without appearing on the ballot.
